> 第5章 君家来袭（第1页）
一声震耳欲聋的狂笑，裹挟着滔天的杀意与毫不掩饰的恶意，如同灭世的雷霆，狠狠劈碎了紫曜神域核心禁地的死寂与期盼！
想复活紫阳神？问过了我君家没有？！”
声音滚滚如潮，撕裂了紫家祖地外围那层层叠叠的禁制光幕！
伴随着这嚣张跋扈到极点的宣告，一股股如同太古凶兽般狂暴、阴冷的恐怖气息，如同决堤的黑色洪流，蛮横无比地冲撞进来！
空间被强行撕裂开一道道巨大的口子，密密麻麻的身影从中踏出！
刚刚发出狂笑的，正是君家八长老——君天命！
他枯瘦的身躯裹在深灰色的狰狞战甲之中，手持一柄流淌着污浊血光的诡异骨杖，那双毒蛇般的眸子死死锁定祭坛顶端那团璀璨到极致、搏动越来越有力的生命光霞，脸上是毫不掩饰的残忍与快意！
另外，还有君家家主君临世，神情冷漠无比盯着祭坛之上，杀机闪烁，不加掩饰！
在他身旁，是君家六长老、七长老等足足几十位长老级存在！
每一位都气息渊深如海，神力澎湃，周身缭绕着各自不同的恐怖异象——或血海沉浮，或白骨铺路，或刀气裂空！
他们如同是几十尊从地狱踏出的魔神，散发出的联合威压，瞬间让紫曜神域的紫色霞光都黯淡了几分！
再其后，则是黑压压一片身着统一制式、铭刻着君家徽记狰狞战甲的修士大军！
杀气冲天，如同冰冷的钢铁洪流，瞬间将这片神圣的紫族核心禁地，化作了即将被鲜血浸染的修罗场！
他伟岸的身躯猛地挺直，一股足以撼动星河的磅礴气势轰然爆发，将那扑面而来的滔天杀意硬生生顶了回去！
他身后的十一位紫家长老，连同原本守护祭坛的十二位长老，此刻再无保留，个个须发皆张，神力如同火山喷发！
但在这愤怒之下，是前所未有的凝重与……决绝！
君家选择在这个最最关键、最最脆弱的时刻发动突袭，其用心之险恶，昭然若揭！
他们不仅要扼杀紫阳神复活的希望，更要趁此良机，一举重创甚至覆灭紫族根基！
君天命狞笑一声，手中污血骨杖猛地向前一指，声音如同刮骨的寒风：
君家长老瞬间化作一道道毁灭性的流光，带着撕裂虚空的尖啸，直扑祭坛！
他们的目标无比明确——打断复活仪式，彻底湮灭那团生命光霞！
他一步踏出，身影瞬间出现在最前方，直接迎上了冲势凶猛的君家长老！
一掌拍出，神能遮蔽苍穹，化作一只遮天蔽日的巨大紫晶手掌，带着碾碎星辰的伟力，狠狠拍落！
君家家主君临世从虚空中一步踏出，战向紫幽冥。
两位家主级巨擘的碰撞，如同两颗太古星辰对撞！
恐怖的能量冲击波瞬间横扫而出，将附近几座悬浮的神山都震得剧烈摇晃，山石崩裂！
若非此地是紫族核心，禁制重重，光是这一击的余波就足以毁灭亿万里河山！
与此同时，紫家其余二十三位长老也悍然迎上了君家另外的长老！
刹那间，这片禁地核心化作了最惨烈的恐怖战场！

> Chapter 5 The Jun family attacks (Page 1)
A deafening roar of laughter, packed with overwhelming murderous intent and undisguised malice, was like a world-destroying thunder, severely shattering the silence and expectations in the forbidden area at the core of the Zi Yao Divine Realm!
Want to resurrect the Purple Sun God? Have you asked my Jun family? ! "
The sound rolled like a tide, tearing apart the layers of restricted light curtains outside the Zi family's ancestral land!
Accompanying this extremely arrogant and domineering declaration, waves of violent and cold terrifying auras like ancient ferocious beasts rushed in arrogantly like a black torrent bursting from a dam!
The space was forcibly torn open with huge holes, and densely packed figures stepped out of it!
The person who just laughed wildly was none other than the eighth elder of the Jun family—Jun Tianming!
His skinny body was wrapped in dark gray ferocious battle armor, and he held a strange bone staff with dirty blood flowing through it. His snake-like eyes were locked on the extremely bright and pulsating life light at the top of the altar. There was undisguised cruelty and pleasure on his face!
In addition, there is Jun, the head of the Jun family, who is staring at the altar with an indifferent expression, murderous intent flashing without concealment!
Beside him were dozens of elder-level beings including the sixth elder and seventh elder of the Jun family!
Each one has an aura as deep as the sea, surging divine power, and is surrounded by different terrifying visions - either the sea of blood rises and falls, or bones pave the way, or the sword energy splits the sky!
They were like dozens of demon gods stepping out of hell. The combined pressure they exuded instantly dimmed the purple glow of the Zi Yao God Realm!
After that, there was a dark army of monks wearing uniform uniforms and ferocious battle armor engraved with the emblem of the Jun family!
The murderous intent surged into the sky, like a torrent of cold steel, instantly turning this sacred core forbidden land of the Purple Clan into a Shura Field that was about to be soaked in blood!
His majestic body suddenly straightened up, and a majestic momentum that could shake the galaxy burst out, forcefully pushing back the overwhelming murderous intent that came towards him!
The eleven purple elders behind him, together with the twelve elders who originally guarded the altar, no longer held back at this moment, their beards and hair were all spread out, and their divine power was like a volcano erupting!
But underneath this anger is unprecedented dignity and... determination!
The Jun family chose to launch a surprise attack at this most critical and vulnerable moment, and their sinister intentions are clearly revealed!
Not only do they want to kill the hope of the Purple Sun God's resurrection, but they also want to take advantage of this opportunity to severely damage or even destroy the foundation of the Purple Clan!
Jun Tianming laughed ferociously, and pointed forward with the blood-stained bone staff in his hand, his voice sounding like the cold wind scraping the bones:
The elders of the Jun family instantly turned into streams of destructive light, carrying screams that tore through the void, heading straight for the altar!
Their goal is extremely clear - to interrupt the resurrection ceremony and completely annihilate the glow of life!
He took one step forward, and his figure instantly appeared at the front, directly facing the fierce charging elder of the monarch!
With one palm strike, the divine energy covered the sky and turned into a huge amethyst palm that covered the sky and the sun. With the power to crush the stars, it struck down hard!
The head of the Jun family, Jun Linshi, stepped out of the void and fought towards Zi Youming.
The collision between the two patriarch-level giants is like the collision of two ancient stars!
The terrifying energy shock wave swept out instantly, shaking several nearby suspended sacred mountains violently, and the rocks cracked!
If this place hadn't been the core of the Purple Clan and had so many restrictions, the aftermath of this attack alone would have been enough to destroy billions of miles of rivers and mountains!
At the same time, the other twenty-three elders of the Zi family also brazenly greeted the other elders of the Jun family!
In an instant, the core of this forbidden area turned into the most brutal and terrifying battlefield!
